overview: The Medford Water and Sewer Commission met to review past minutes, postpone scheduled abatement appeals, and discuss water system infrastructure funding, rate setting, and unaccounted-for water loss.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the previous meeting held on February 22.

items.title: Commitments
items.summary: The commission postponed action on commitments until the next meeting to allow for proper signatures.

items.title: Abatement Appeal: 5A Ashland Street
items.summary: The abatement appeal for 5A Ashland Street was deferred after determining the applicant was not in attendance.

items.title: Medford Housing Abatements
items.summary: Staff presented 28 abatement requests from Medford Housing concerning late fees and returned check interest, which were deferred for further review at the next meeting.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The commission considered upcoming meeting dates for April, May, and June to coordinate member and public availability.

items.title: Water Rates and System Infrastructure Discussion
items.summary: Commission members and department staff discussed long-term capital plans for replacing aging water mains, future rate structures, the use of retained earnings, and plans to locate uncounted water loss.
